policy: Only reviewed, zero-cost sources marked approved may be used as automated production data sources. CINEMAP remains personal and non-commercial.

sources.name: TMDB
sources.basis: Official developer API; non-commercial use with attribution.
requirements: Use approved TMDB logo
Display required TMDB attribution notice in Credits/About
Non-commercial developer API only unless commercial license is obtained

sources.name: JustWatch via TMDB Watch Providers
sources.basis: TMDB Watch Providers endpoint explicitly permits use with mandatory JustWatch attribution.
requirements: Attribute JustWatch as source of watch-provider data

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.basis: Wikidata structured data is released under CC0.
requirements: Retain source/provenance where practical

sources.name: Filmarks
sources.basis: No licensed data API or explicit permission held by CINEMA DAYS.
requirements: No scraping
No ratings/reviews/rankings storage
Normal outbound links only

sources.name: 109 Cinemas
sources.basis: No explicit permission currently held for automated collection/republication.
requirements: Do not automate until written permission or a licensed API is available

sources.name: Netflix public web pages
sources.basis: No explicit permission currently held for automated HTML collection/republication.
requirements: Do not scrape

sources.name: Nippon TV / 金曜ロードショー public web pages
sources.basis: No explicit permission currently held for automated HTML collection/republication.
requirements: Do not scrape

sources.name: 興行通信社
sources.basis: No permission held for automated collection/republication.
requirements: Do not scrape or republish rankings without permission/license

sources.name: OpenAI API
sources.basis: Paid/metered API is outside CINEMAP zero-cost policy.
requirements: Do not call from production CINEMAP

sources.name: Vercel Hobby
sources.basis: Free plan for personal, non-commercial projects; usage limits apply.
requirements: Personal/non-commercial use only
Do not upgrade to paid plan for CINEMAP
Treat free-tier exhaustion as downtime, not a billing trigger

sources.name: GitHub Pages
sources.basis: Permitted for project static sites subject to Pages terms and usage limits.
requirements: Do not operate CINEMAP as commercial SaaS/e-commerce on Pages
Stay within Pages usage limits

sources.name: YouTube API Services
sources.basis: Potential source for human criticism discovery, but production use is gated until CINEMAP has the required YouTube API Client terms/privacy disclosures, credential handling, display/storage rules, and the exact CRITIC MAP design passes a fresh compliance review.
requirements: Use documented YouTube API Services only; no scraping
Do not download/cache/store audiovisual content
Do not expose API credentials in the frontend or repository
Publish and surface the required privacy policy and YouTube Terms links before enabling
Respect API-data refresh/storage limits
Do not create derived metrics from YouTube API Data
Clearly label CINEMAP-owned classifications as not from YouTube
Keep disabled until these requirements are implemented and reviewed

sources.name: 午前十時の映画祭 公式サイト
sources.basis: Official event site; CINEMAP stores a manually reviewed factual schedule snapshot and links back to the official source. No automated scraping.
requirements: Manual review only
Store factual titles/dates/group labels with source URL
Do not copy editorial text, images, or automate HTML collection
Refresh by human review when the official schedule changes

sources.name: Premium-format official theater/brand pages
sources.basis: Official IMAX, Dolby, TOHO Cinemas, T-Joy, Aeon Cinema and other exhibitor pages; CINEMAP stores manually reviewed factual format/theater/screen labels with outbound source links.
requirements: Manual review only
Store factual theater/format/screen labels and source URLs
No automated scraping
Prefer direct official theater/brand pages and periodically recheck current status
